messages.subject: Project Harbor - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Harbor completed at 14.50 today. The executed share purchase agreement is attached. Funds have flowed: £34.11m to Castle & Vane and £3.79m into the Retention Account. Final terms - £41.5m enterprise value, £37.9m initial consideration, 20% liability cap (£7.58m), 18-month warranty period (7 years tax), 3-year non-compete, earn-out up to £4m on FY27 EBITDA. Congratulations to all. Post-completion filings to follow.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
